preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100 for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string in the test cases must have a length between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(s.islower() and s.isalpha() for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string in the test cases must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if len(s) % 2 == 0 and s[:len(s)//2] == s[len(s)//2:] else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if the string is square, otherwise output 'NO'.
